name: The Cars
bio: The Cars has a catalog with durable streaming, playlist, publishing, and licensing value that makes it a useful future addition to How Much Music.
notable_for: The Cars is best known here for signature songs that remain recognizable enough to support long-tail catalog demand.
career_highlight: Songs like Drive and Just What I Needed can anchor the artist page with clear catalog economics and internal links.
revenue_drivers: Catalog streaming and playlist use keep the core songs active.
Live-culture recognition and sync use can renew demand.
Long-tail fan discovery supports recurring earnings beyond release cycles.
